{{Otheruses|Blue Harvest}}
'''''Blue Harvest''''' was a novel written and published sometime prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. One of the protagonists was [[Corellian Security Forces|CorSec]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Antilles (Blue Harvest)|Antilles]].<ref name="SWG:BHC1">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|BLUE HARVEST (Chapter 1)}}</ref>

==Excerpt==
{{ExcerptIU
|''The Trandoshan stood his ground, blood dripping from the blade in his hand.''<br/>
''"You didn't see it!"  He shouted.''<br/>
''CorSec officer Antilles lowered his pistol.  The Trandoshan didn't seem to be threatening him at all.  He was terrified.''<br/>
''"What was it?"''<br/>
''"I don't know!"  The Trandoshan was nearly in tears.  His body was covered with the strange ichor that Officer Antilles had seen at the other crime scenes.''<br/>
''"Did you kill it?"''<br/>
''The Trandoshan shook his head.  He didn't think so.  He thought, in fact, that he'd simply angered it.  Trandoshans are a cold blooded species, one of the most cruel races the galaxy had to offer.  But this one was shaken to his very core.''
|attrib=An excerpt of the first chapter of ''Blue Harvest''<ref name="SWG:BHC1" />}}
